description.narrative: Humanitarian support to IR for project increasing access to clean water for population affected by drought in Pakistan and project to increase food security in Gaza.
Humanitärt stöd till IR för projekt som ökar tillgång till rent vatten för befolkning drabbad av torka i Pakistan och för projekt för att öka matsäkerhet i Gaza.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Mali: The project has worked on close cooperartion with affected communities. Livelyhoods activites in agriculture as well as cash for work activities have improved household economy and helped reduce land degradation through tree planting.
Tchad: Access to water, both throught wells and rain water harvest has impropved health and livelyhoods and made target communities more resilient to stress and schocks.
Lebanon: NFI kits were distributed to refugees from Syria.
Palestine/Gaza: The target group for cash for work activites have impropved their income, both for personal financial inddependence and fror family assets for food and health expences.
Pakistan: Imprpved access to clean and reliable water has imprved health and also improved the situation for women who need to spend less time on fetching water, as the wells were constructed closer to the target households.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
